agents.name: PlannerAgent
agents.role: Chooses registry queries and extraction targets; revises the plan from feedback

agents.name: EvidenceAgent
agents.role: Runs registry queries via the data layer, guards vendor text, extracts quoted claims

agents.name: EvaluatorAgent
agents.role: Grounds claims, derives facts, critiques coverage and requests verification

agents.name: ChallengerAgent
agents.role: Stress-tests a favourable decision; can only accept, re-plan or escalate

agents.name: ReporterAgent
agents.role: Writes a cited report of the policy decision, or the deterministic template
